How Fit uses your health data

With your permission, Fit reads these from Health Connect: workouts and their routes, steps, distance, calories burned, nutrition, hydration, cycle tracking, sleep, weight, height, heart rate, resting heart rate, blood oxygen and breathing rate. If you also allow it, Fit reads data older than 30 days, so it can import your whole history. Fit uses this data only to show you your activity, trends and history in Tenshu\'s apps.
Fit only reads. It never writes to or changes your data in Health Connect.
Fit keeps your health data on this device and syncs it, end-to-end encrypted, only to your own devices. Tenshu\'s servers cannot read it, and it is never used for advertising.
You can change or withdraw Fit\'s access at any time in Health Connect.
